title: DScale: Scaling Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Verification
abstract: arXiv:2609.37532v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Growing large language model applications demand efficient inference. At high concurrency, block-diffusion speculative decoding suffers from verification padding, rejected candidates, and incompatibility between variable prefixes and fixed-shape graphs. Uniform truncation sacrifices acceptable tokens. We present DScale, preserving drafter architecture, weights, and full draft length. A separate 112K-parameter predictor requires neither confidence calibration nor hardware speed-curve preparation. Path-aware tiles reduce padding. Dynamic verify-length (DVL) allocation packs scored prefixes into half the native verification capacity. Fixed-address workspaces propagate changing boundaries through verification and acceptance while reusing captured graphs. On A100-40GB with tensor parallelism 1, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B cover four datasets and concurrency 8-32, reusing each target's frozen predictor. Geometric-mean throughput gains across these

translated_title: DScale：通过自适应验证实现块扩散推测解码的扩展
translated_abstract: 日益增长的大语言模型应用对高效推理提出了需求。在高并发场景下，块扩散推测解码面临验证填充、候选结果被拒绝、以及可变前缀与固定形状计算图不兼容等问题，而均匀截断会牺牲本可被接受的token。我们提出了DScale，它保留了草稿模型的架构、权重和完整的草稿长度。一个独立的112K参数预测器既不需要置信度校准，也不需要预先准备硬件速度曲线。路径感知的分块减少了填充开销。动态验证长度（DVL）分配将已评分的前缀打包进原生验证容量的一半空间中。固定地址的工作区在验证与接受过程中传播变化的边界，同时复用已捕获的计算图。在A100-40GB上以张量并行度为1的设置下，Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-4B覆盖了四个数据集和8-32的并发度范围，并复用每个目标模型的冻结预测器。在这些设置下的几何平均吞吐量提升……
tldr: DScale通过一个仅112K参数的轻量级预测器、路径感知分块和动态验证长度分配，在不修改草稿模型架构与权重的前提下自适应优化块扩散推测解码的验证过程，在高并发场景下显著提升大语言模型推理吞吐量。
en_tdlr: DScale adaptively optimizes block-diffusion speculative decoding verification through a lightweight 112K-parameter predictor, path-aware tiling, and dynamic verify-length allocation, significantly boosting LLM inference throughput under high concurrency while preserving the drafter's architecture, weights, and full draft length.
